detail.longDescription:
Are you ready for the ultimate AI friendship experience?

Jupi is an app that lets you create your own AI characters and friends to chat and interact with. Customize your character's looks, voice, persona and style according to your liking. Later on, either share it with other users in the app or keep it private to yourself.

Imagine anyone and digitally bring him or her to life. You can create historical figures, anime, fantasy or game characters, or even an original character entirely your own. The possibilities are endless!

Key Features:

- 20,000+ AI powered characters and chatbots to talk to, ranging from a friendly neighbor to a wise wizard. It's so much fun! New characters added every day!

- Create your own AI character if you like. Just describe how the AI should behave, set its voice, avatar and virtually bring anyone to life!

- AI driven experiences. Dive into immersive, interactive adventures. Become a detective solving a mysterious crime, explore enchanted worlds or embark on captivating story-driven journeys unlike any other. The possibilities are endless!

- Ask any question to Jupi AI Assistant and you'll immediately get answers. It can help you as an educator, content creator, translator, a personal coach or simply as a friend.

- Ability to send voice messages & get replies with realistic speech.

- Ability to share your characters within the app or with friends or family.

- You don't need any accounts or registration. Just download the app and start using. If you want more features and access to all characters, feel free to subscribe to our Premium upgrade.

DISCLAIMER: Entertainment Only

This app is designed solely for entertainment purposes. The chatbots and their responses are fictional, generated by AI and should not be taken seriously or relied upon for real-life decisions. All characters and conversations are entirely fictional and have no affiliation with real people, public figures, or brands. Enjoy responsibly.

Reach us at jupi@jupi.chat if you have any questions or feedback.
